procedure.grouping: eligible training trials sorted by original row, then divided into contiguous groups of near-equal size with the earliest groups taking any remainder
procedure.normalization: fitted on each fold's training trials, applied unchanged to its assessment trials
procedure.metric: arithmetic mean of the per-axis coefficient of determination on concatenated out-of-fold predictions
procedure.models: temporary Ridge models, discarded after selection
